versions.name: Backpacking
versions.description: Cut pack weight without cutting safety, treat your own water, navigate with map and compass, cook on a lightweight stove, and build up to a five-day trek covering thirty miles across three campsites.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
